facts.fact: The lowland runner (Varun's middleman) is a thin man with a bad left foot who drinks in the salt-road inns; Asha has seen him at a table with Varun.
The salt road runs up behind the walnut terraces, over two spurs and down the dry side of Garh Neshar; it has not been warded in fifty winters and is illegal in nine places.
Pinku watched from the walnut tree when Meera hid the seal in the woodpile and told Nimmi at dusk.

Asha's crew tied the lockhouse sentries' hands in the three-nested-loop knot matching the juniper bundle and the cairn carving; Meera notices it (count note 'Same as cairn') and Asha cuts her off with a look.
